copy_ready_message: Could you spend 2 minutes reviewing my Data Quality Agent demo? Open this card, inspect one result, and leave one concrete public note if you are comfortable: https://sunnnn2005.github.io/data-quality-agent/two-minute-review-card.html

micro_steps.action: Open the hosted demo and inspect the support-ticket data-quality result.
micro_steps.label: Open the public demo

micro_steps.action: Choose one concrete observation about the report, agent behavior, guardrails, or UI.
micro_steps.label: Pick one useful or confusing detail

micro_steps.action: Open the feedback issue template and include permission/no-private-data checks.
micro_steps.label: Submit public evidence

not_claimed: business impact validated by a company
purpose: Give a busy reviewer the shortest safe path to produce the first countable public feedback item without inflating users, stars, or adoption.
required_evidence: what page, command, or route was reviewed
one useful, confusing, or missing detail
confirmation that no private data was posted
resume_safe_summary: Published a two-minute external review card with 3 micro-steps, 5 required evidence fields, and zero outcome upgrades until a non-owner public issue passes the evidence gate.
success_definition: One non-owner GitHub issue that includes a concrete observation, explicit permission to count, and no private data.
